ulb.description: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB Machine Learning Group / Worldline), 284,807 transactions, 492 frauds, two days, September 2013
ulb.citation: Dal Pozzolo, Caelen, Johnson, Bontempi. Calibrating probability with undersampling for unbalanced classification. IEEE SSCI 2015
ulb.notes: Public GitHub mirror of the Kaggle release (mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud, licence ODbL, contents DbCL v1.0). PCA features rounded to 9 decimals in this mirror; row and fraud counts match the original.

banksim.citation: Lopez-Rojas, Axelsson. BankSim: A bank payments simulator for fraud detection research. EMSS 2014
banksim.notes: Public GitHub mirror of the Kaggle release (ealaxi/banksim1).
